12795919411d2e855b40422a8b67a51473b4635f.content: The modern adapter opens .kin/local/kindex in the actual Git worktree and does not fall back to Personal or read clone-controlled data_dir settings. Legacy profiles remain explicitly available. Shared .kin/knowledge.json contains selected public/team semantic evidence; imports remain quarantined, not Company authority.

2e4591fb830eb2173da98b0410b1ae455f0b48e4.content: Claude function hooks are qualified against 2.1.263 and installed separately from legacy command hooks. Raw prompt enqueue precedes function hooks, so all-host-log secrecy is not claimed. Typed task effects commit with scoped replay receipts and audit outbox. Full Kindex 1.0 release remains uncut; early-access host qualification is separate from core compatibility.

539642834b049fe52291431c0d941af78b08b141.content: Kindex owns durable task and knowledge state. signet-eval owns local coding-model enforcement and host interception; Signet is the separate outward-action product. Kindex sink containment remains local even with signet-eval installed. No third package is required for this integration.
